environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order before the default target group forward. Priority 1: a custom rule matching requests where the query string contains patterns commonly associated with SQL meta-characters, configured via a regex condition on query_string with pattern '.*(['\'';]|(--)|(\\x27)|(UNION)|(SELECT)|(INSERT)|(DROP)|(UPDATE)|(DELETE)|(EXEC)|(CHAR\\()).*' (case-insensitive), returning fixed 403 response. Priority 2: AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to the ALB with AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet and AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet both in COUNT mode only (for monitoring). The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB health check endpoint. Task uses read-only root filesystem with /var/data mounted as an EFS volume with encryption at rest.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with listener rule priority 1: query_string regex condition blocking SQL meta-characters (returns 403)
config.wafv2: WebACL with AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet and AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in COUNT mode (logging only, not blocking)
config.ecs_network: private subnet, egress restricted via security group to ALB health check only
